title: Review of c15's nematic fuel-cell (SIBD): ring, rods and ringed fission replicate on seed 11, but a ringless twin with uniformly slower fuel diffusion matches the ring's fuel and division effect
summary: Fresh seed 11 of the claimed world: rods nucleate from noise, 96% of 161 body-frames carry a closed s ring (independent rim-vs-medial-axis measure, axisring.py: rim/axis 2.20, rim/outside 4.16), and the colony makes 15 persistent splits to generation 3 (merge/split 0.09) with ringed figure-8 fission at the deepest generation (fission_gen3_seed11.png). The chi_s=0 control on the same seed removes the ring (0%) and lowers axis fuel 0.585 -> 0.358, but still divides to generation 3 (10 persistent splits), a smaller gap than the claim's seeds 0-2. A new control the claim lacks, a ringless (chi_s=0) twin with fuel diffusivity lowered uniformly, reproduces the ring's work: Df 0.5 gives axis fuel 0.51 and 12 splits gen 3, Df 0.2 gives 0.70 and 17 splits gen 4, more than the ringed world. S, I, B and D are supported as listed; the ring's work is real but is what slower diffusion does, so it should not be scored as containment beyond diffusion (consistent with the established FCH slow-D law).

observations.S: rerun/seed11/sheet.png t=0 is uniform noise; rods appear by t=135
observations.I: rerun/seed11/sheet.png: 7-25 discrete rods of bounded width (~4 px) persisting between fissions, t=135-1000
observations.B: axisring.py on rerun/seed11/frames.npz: 154/161 body-frames ring-like, median rim/axis 2.20, rim/outside 4.16; chi_s=0 (rerun_chis0/seed11): 0/117, rim/axis 0.88; profile_s11.png shows s peaking within 1 px either side of phi=0
observations.D: rerun/seed11/lineage.png: 15 persistent splits, max generation 3, merge/split 0.087 from noise-born founders; fission_gen3_seed11.png (births at frames 151-156, gen-3 chain founder 0 -> 14 -> 33 -> 45/46) shows the ring pinching into a figure-8 and both daughters leaving ringed

seeds_run.result: pass: 15 persistent splits gen 3, 96% ringed, axis fuel 0.585

controls_run.B: rerun_chis0/seed11 (chi_s=0: ring gone, 0% ring-like, axis fuel 0.358, 10 persistent splits gen 3)
controls_run.D: rerun_chis0/seed11 as above; lowered-D ringless twins rerun_chis0_Df05/seed11 (Df 0.5: axis fuel 0.512, 12 splits gen 3, 0% ringed) and rerun_chis0_Df02/seed11 (Df 0.2: axis fuel 0.696, 17 splits gen 4, 0% ringed)

verdicts.limitation: The ring's work (holding fuel, raising division) is reproduced without any ring by lowering the fuel diffusivity uniformly 4-10x on the same seed: the ring acts as a slow-diffusion barrier and is not beyond diffusion; a W or BD score for it would need a twin it beats. On seed 11 the ring-off control also reaches generation 3 (10 vs 15 splits), so the division effect is quantitative and smaller than on the claim's seeds. One fresh seed only; motility 2.2 body lengths (not claimed). The rim score is at dx=1 with a 1-2 px ring; no resolution test.
